name: Humanity's Last Prayer
description:
About This Game

Humanity’s Last Prayer

An ancient evil has descended upon the earth, driving humanity’s last survivors into a mountain sanctuary. They have uncovered a forgotten ritual that could save the world—but its power must be drawn from the destruction of the very hordes that threaten it.

You alone can sound the sacred horn that calls them forth. Summon the enemy, slaughter them, and fuel humanity’s last prayer.

Protect the Priests

Six priests hold the ritual together. When you fall, one gives their life to destroy the wave and bring you back. When the last priest is gone, no one is left to save you.

Build on Your Own Terms

Every skill, passive, and crafting system is open to you from the start. Pursue the mechanics that interest you, explore how they work together, and shape your character around the build you want to create.

There is no prescribed route to power. How you grow—and when you are ready to face the final encounter—is up to you.

Compete on Execution

Climb the leaderboards through efficient progression, thoughtful build choices, and precise combat. Only active combat time counts, so take the time you need to compare equipment, explore the systems, and plan your next move. When you sound the horn, put your preparation to the test.

Features

  • Action hack-and-slash combat against waves of hundreds of enemies.

  • Deep ARPG build crafting through interconnected stats, skills, and passives.

  • Extensive item crafting and powerful loot to shape your character.

  • Every skill, passive, and crafting system available from the start.

  • Competitive leaderboards measured by active combat time.

Play Online or Offline

Humanity’s Last Prayer is a solo game. Play offline with characters saved to your own PC, or sign in through Steam to play an online character with server-saved progression and leaderboards. There is no co-op or PvP.
short_desc: Humanity’s Last Prayer is a dark-fantasy arena ARPG where you defend humanity’s final sanctuary. Summon hundreds of enemies in waves and slaughter them to fuel humanity’s last prayer. Shape your character through deep build and item crafting systems.
